name: Send an inquiry through WhatsApp
description: Verifies the frontend validates a visitor inquiry and opens WhatsApp with the entered details.
steps: Enter a valid name, email, phone, ministry, and message
Agree to the data-use notice and submit
Confirm the page reports success and WhatsApp opens with the entered details
expected: A success message appears, WhatsApp opens with the inquiry details, and the three contact numbers are available in the contact area.

name: Use the mobile menu and event calendar
description: Verifies the mobile menu navigates and closes and the event calendar action is available.
steps: Choose FAQ and confirm the menu closes at the FAQ section
Return to the event section and select Add to Calendar
expected: Navigation reaches the chosen section, the menu closes, and an 11/11 Roundtable calendar file downloads.

name: Reject invalid inquiry and expand FAQ
description: Verifies invalid form details show helpful errors and FAQ answers expand accessibly.
steps: Enter invalid email and phone values and submit again
expected: Required-field and invalid-contact errors appear, then the selected FAQ answer expands.

name: Explore the event media showcase
covers: slideshow navigation without visible photo numbers
multi-photo uploads grouped into year albums
flyer autoplay fade, pause, swipe, arrows, dots, and slide counter
sequential two-video playback using ended events
shared muted state and Tap to unmute control
video play/pause, progress, volume, and tab controls
pause video when outside viewport and resume when visible
placeholder fallbacks for media not yet uploaded
responsive side-by-side desktop and stacked mobile media layout
description: Verifies the added flyer and video showcase provides accessible slideshow and player controls, graceful media placeholders, and responsive layout.
steps: Open the Media Showcase section and advance between flyers with arrow, dot, and keyboard controls
Confirm the counter and active gold dot update, then open and close the flyer lightbox
Select a video tab, unmute, and use the play, progress, volume, and pause controls
Allow a video to end and confirm the other starts, then scroll the player out of view and back
Check the showcase stacks on a mobile viewport without horizontal scrolling
expected: The six-slide carousel advances and can be paused and navigated accessibly; the lightbox opens; the two videos retain the shared mute state and switch sequentially; missing media shows a clear fallback; and the showcase stacks on mobile.
